name: Reading
description: Reading word search puzzles gather bookish English for adults and seniors — chapter, shelf, novel, preface, glossary and quiet lamp-side words — without publisher or bookstore brands. Play free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No account and no timer: just the calm vocabulary of evening pages and library afternoons. Short desk words such as page, note and line keep beginners moving; longer anchors like epilogue, biography and paragraph steady harder boards. Pair with Libraries and Journaling for a wider study hour, or open Large Print when reading glasses are already in use. Written for lifelong readers, not for children's worksheet kits.
